title: Correct final pressure
description: Essential: The final answer must be 204 N (or equivalent) for the pressure exerted by the person on the platform.

title: Correct direction
description: Essential: The answer must specify the pressure is vertically downward, or the force is 204 N downward.

title: System free-body diagram
description: Important: The solution must correctly identify the system (person+platform) and apply Newton's second law to find the rope tension.

title: Person free-body diagram
description: Important: The solution must isolate the person and apply Newton's second law to relate normal force, tension, weight, and acceleration.

title: Tension calculation
description: Important: The rope tension must be correctly calculated as ((M+m)(a+g))/2.

title: Newton's third law application
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's third law to equate the normal force from the platform on the person to the pressure exerted by the person on the platform.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All calculations should use consistent SI units (kg, m/s², N) and include units in the final answer.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Using g - a or a - g incorrectly when writing the net force equation.

title: Tension misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assuming the tension equals the weight of the system or neglecting the pulley's mechanical advantage (factor of 2).
